construction: ChatGPT created controlled claim pairs around propositions from the three development papers. Positive, condition-shift, paraphrase, unrelated and underspecified cases were included deliberately.
permitted_claim: The labels support provisional engineering calibration of a contradiction-warning confidence threshold.
limitations: The set is small and uses one AI annotator.
Many pairs are controlled challenge examples rather than naturally occurring cross-paper disagreements.
Threshold selection and model evaluation on this same development set are not independent evidence of accuracy.
